title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The Fed's rate is 4.75% or higher after its April 28, 2027 meeting

If the Fed raises in December, January and March the rate is already 4.75% after March; it stays at or above that unless April brings a cut. Polymarket's April-decision market puts a cut at about 12% unconditionally, and a cut one meeting after three straight rises is less likely than that, so 0.92.
